## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what this change makes possible. Link a related issue when available.

## Validation

List checks actually performed and relevant results. Explain skipped checks and remaining limitations.

## Compatibility and operations

Mention API/schema changes, permissions, migrations, backups, deployment requirements and third-party dependencies when relevant. Write "None" if there are no operational changes.

- [ ] Documentation and translations are updated where needed.
- [ ] Relevant tests/checks passed; skipped checks are clearly stated.
- [ ] Fixtures, screenshots and logs contain no private data or credentials.

For vulnerabilities, use the private channel in SECURITY.md before opening a public pull request with exploit details.
